_about: Four movie pages read from production on 2026-10-04 in a read-only session: each page's ScrapedTrue and Scraped arrays as stored, with the verdict ScrapedVerdict holds for each (hash, title) pair (null: not judged yet) and, for a trash verdict, when ScrapedTrash first recorded that pair being moved off this table's page.

Drawn from 400 randomly chosen judged movie pages: 27 of the 393 with a ScrapedTrue row still carried 137 results with a trash verdict, these four among them. Every one of those 33 results here had been moved to ScrapedTrash before and written back by a scraper since: the page's updatedAt is later than its checkpoint.
checkpoint is the verdict pass's Cache record for the page (verdicts:checked:movie:<id>).
